correctness.rationale: On g1(α)=(α²−2α−1)(α²+2α−1)=α⁴−6α²+1=0 the z3⁴ term in the plane quartic cancels. Since α²+1≠0 at all four roots, projection from source unique ordinary node [0:0:1] gives 6(α²+1)(x²+1)z3²=x⁴−6x²+1. Multiply z3 by sqrt(6(α²+1))(x²+1) to obtain the same quadratic function-field extension y²=(x²+1)(x⁴−6x²+1) for each α. The sextic expands to x⁶−5x⁴−5x²+1 and is squarefree, so normalization has genus two. Naskręcki proves irreducibility, genus and nodality; Goldstein–Guralnick–Howe–Zieve record Igusa’s reduced geometric S4 classification for this exact sextic over char≠2,5, giving full Aut order 48 over C. Independently reverified symbolic g1, square-free sextic, node coefficient and distinct roots.
